Triage: lands across `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` and `skills/objectstack-pm-dispatch/**` ⇒ `domain:skills` (both skill roots and the agent-instruction files sit in that lane). Graded `Task` · `priority:p2`.

`Task` rather than `Bug`: no declared contract is being violated by code. A form of words is being replaced with an executable one.

`priority:p2` on what the unexecutable form actually does, which is worse than "imprecise wording": 「先报告 / 先确认 / 先问,再继续」 addressed to a one-shot executor **presupposes a mid-run channel that executor does not have**. So the fence does not fence — it silently hands the executor the whole three-way choice (do and report / don't / decide alone) that the author believed they had reserved. That is an incident class (#14017), not a style preference, and the criterion exists because it already cost something.

⛔ Not p1: the criterion **is landed** (ruled A on #14031, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` via PR #14697), so new dispatch words are already written correctly. What remains is the back-catalogue.

### The fences on this card are unusually good and should be carried into the dispatch verbatim

- ⛔ Not a second ruling on the criterion. ⛔ Not a change to what any fence *means* — only to its form. ⛔ Not the published `skills/**` catalog beyond the pm-dispatch package, because customer-facing skills address readers who **can** ask.
- Every PR **shrink-or-neutral** under both the line ratchet (`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`) and the token ratchet (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`). ⛔ No ceiling raise; ⛔ no re-wrap funding. ⭐ The card's own observation is the reason this is realistic rather than optimistic: **an executable form is usually shorter than the form it replaces**, because "do X and record the judgement" is fewer words than "stop, report, and wait".
- ⛔ No one-line note at each rewrite site — the criterion lives in one place and the rewrites just obey it. Worth flagging to the dev, since annotating each site is the instinctive move and it would blow the ratchet.

### ⚠️ Two things this grading adds

**The governed endgame applies to every PR in this family.** All the named surfaces are on the governed register (`.claude/**`, `skills/**`), so ⛔ no PR here flips ready, enqueues, or arms auto-merge on its own: review recorded on the issue, review requested from both authorized accounts, and a human merge or an authorized approval releases it. One PR per governed surface, as the card already scopes.

**The census is the deliverable even if the rewrites stall.** The measured list — `file:line`, the sentence verbatim, and which of the two executable forms it becomes — has standalone value: it is the first count of how large the back-catalogue is. ⇒ If the rewrite PRs turn out to be more than one sitting, land the census and let the rewrites follow, rather than holding both.

The surfaces this card counts are being rewritten rules-only under the maintainer's 2026-09-04 rulings (#13597): `SKILL.md` on PR #15460, seven core references on PR #15485, the remaining references and `lanes/**` next, then `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` and the published `skills/objectstack-pm-dispatch/**`. Each remaining member's brief carries this card's criterion verbatim: an instruction addressed to a one-shot executor must be terminal within the run — either allow-with-trace (make the minimal edit and list the judgement and the rollback in the report) or forbid (do not touch it; let the gate stay red there and name the site in the report); the 「先报告 / 先确认 / 先问,再继续」 form is not written. A census over a corpus that is being rewritten would measure the wrong text, so the census PR (the measured `file:line` list and any residual rewrites) is dispatched once those members are on `main`; it carries `Fixes` for this card. Every PR stays shrink-or-neutral under both ratchets, as the card fences.

# Census: the unexecutable "report / confirm / ask first, then continue" fence form

Read-only flight. No file written, no PR opened. Deliverable 1 of this card (the measured list) only;
deliverable 2 (the rewrites) stays fenced behind the family.

## The criterion, quoted (not re-argued)

The landed bullet from PR #14697 lives in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md`
(blob `f8d8d730`), in the 派发词构造细则 section, as a four-line cluster. Quoted verbatim:

```text
194: - 停条件写法:要证据不要判决,且动作须在本轮内终局。
197: - 可执行性判据:一次性 dev 无中途提问的通道,先问再继续预设了不存在的续接。
198: - 两种改写都在一轮内闭合:允许做 ⇒ 只做最小编辑,并在报告里单列该判断与回退方式。
199: - 不许做 ⇒ ⛔ 不要动该文件,让门禁红着并在报告里点名该站点。
```

Line 197 is the criterion; 198 and 199 are the two executable forms this census sorts hits into.
This flight applies it and does not redefine it.

## The measured list — 3 hits

| # | file:line | blob | sentence (verbatim) | form | reason |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:38` | `b2913e63` | `PR 上不是你设置的状态属于另一个 actor:去问,⛔ 永不去纠正。` | **forbid** | 「去问」 demands a mid-run question of an executor that has no channel to ask through, and nothing in the sentence ends the run — so the three-way collapse applies exactly (ask-in-the-report and carry on / block / decide alone). Line 40 of the same file already supplies the executable half (「把意外写进 summary」); 「去问」 is the vestige. |
| 2 | `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md:212` | `f8d8d730` | `若实测表明真正的生产者在别包,报备后按生产者侧修,落点与理由写进报告和 PR 正文。` | **allow-with-trace** | This is dispatch-word boilerplate the PM must copy verbatim (line 211: 「文件面两句原文照抄」), so it reaches a one-shot dev unaltered. 「报备后按生产者侧修」 sequences a notification BEFORE an action that then continues — the notification has no mid-run carrier, and the sentence's own second half proves it, because the only reporting channel it names (报告 and PR body) arrives after the fix, not before it. |
| 3 | `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:542` | `520c35c4` | `文件面写两句:预期落点;生产者在别包时报备后按生产者侧修,⛔ 不在消费者侧打补丁。` | **allow-with-trace** | The same clause in the PM's own instruction on what the dispatch word must say to the dev — and here without even the trace half that hit 2 carries. Addressee is transitive but real: this line's whole job is to specify text addressed to a one-shot executor. |

Hits 2 and 3 are one clause with two homes; the executable rewrite is the same for both — drop the
「报备后」 sequencing and keep the trace: fix at the producer, record the landing point and the
reasoning in the report and the PR body.

**Hits per file:** `os-dev.md` 1 · `references/dispatch-runbook.md` 1 · `SKILL.md` 1 · the other 22 files 0.
**Hits per form:** allow-with-trace 2 · forbid 1.

⭐ None of the three falls in the thirteen files frozen on PR #15641's head — so this reading does not
depend on that PR landing.

## Controls, both directions

**Direction A — looks like the form, is executable (excluded).** Three named, all sharing one property:
the demanded action ENDS the run, so nothing is presupposed of an absent reader.

- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:31` — `探针遇 403 ⇒ 停下报 blocked,⛔ 不进重试循环;只有网络错误才退避重试。`
  「停下报」 reads like 「先报告」, but `blocked` is a named terminal report status and nothing is
  demanded after it.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:540` — `dev 装不下预算 ⇒ 停手回报,⛔ 不自行扩写、不自行抬预算。`
  Same shape, dev-addressed, no continuation.
- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:356` — `每个方案逐轴分析,推荐也按那些轴给理由;派发词没带,停下向 PM 索取,⛔ 不自拟一套轴。`
  The sharpest control: it literally names an ask directed at the PM. It is still excluded, because
  「停下」 makes the ask the run's final act rather than a mid-run one. This is the discriminator the
  criterion supplies — 「再继续」, the continuation, is what makes a hit, not the presence of an ask.

**Direction B — a live positive.** #14031's own measured sentence (「动手前先报告」, from dispatch word
#13981) does NOT survive on these surfaces: it lived in a dispatch word, never in the skills corpus.
Probe `grep -n "动手前先报告"` over all 25 files returns zero, and the same grep run for the control word
「报告」 matches on 110 lines across 12 of them, so the zero is a reading and not a broken probe.

The nearest surviving relative is hit 2 / hit 3, and it is structurally identical to the retired example:
「动手前先报告」 sequenced a report before an action; 「报备后按生产者侧修」 sequences a notification
before an action. Same presupposition, same three-way collapse. The reading is live.

## Coverage — so silence can be told from absence

Instruction unit = one bullet or numbered line. Re-derivable over the 25 files with
`grep -cE '^[[:space:]]*(-|[0-9]+\.)[[:space:]]' FILE`.

| population | count |
|:--|--:|
| instruction units examined, all 25 files | 2283 |
| of those, addressed to a one-shot executor (the population the criterion can apply to) | 440 |
| — `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, whole file | 327 |
| — `skills/objectstack-pm-dispatch/rules/dev-template.md`, whole file | 17 |
| — internal SKILL.md + references, lines naming `dev` as the actor | 94 |
| — published SKILL.md, the two dispatch-prompt non-negotiables | 2 |
| **hits** | **3** |
| examined within that population and judged NOT of the form | 437 |
| excluded: addressee is a session-type seat (PM / triage / director) that does have a mid-run channel | 1843 |

Plus one prose block examined outside the bullet count: the published SKILL.md decision-frame stop
trigger (lines 630-636), which the PM pastes into every dev prompt. Judged not of the form — it returns
`needs_decision`, which is terminal.

The 94-line dev-addressed subset inside the PM corpus is a mechanical proxy (lines naming `dev`), read
individually; the addressee judgement itself is not mechanical, and the exclusion of 1843 seat-addressed
units rests on it. Stated so a reader can retest it rather than inherit it.

## What the count says about the back-catalogue

Three hits in 440 dev-addressed instruction units, and two of them are one clause with two homes.
The back-catalogue this card was opened to size is small — smaller than the card's own warning allowed
for. The reason is visible in the corpus: the criterion has already been applied ahead of the census.
`dispatch-runbook.md:120` (`⛔ 不为提问或中期汇报结束回合;开放选择按裁决与评估轴自裁,记入终报 open_questions。`)
and `dispatch-runbook.md:196` (`⛔ 不写成发现消费者就停下:那把判决权交回被停的一方。`) are the
anti-form written as standing rules, and the rules-only rewrites of `SKILL.md`, the seven core references
and `os-dev.md` carried the criterion into each member's brief, as this card's own 2026-09-04 disposition
recorded. The census measures the residue, not the original population.
